turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call after that. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Start with why nobody called me first.
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
We're not here about the parking. I asked you a question, Hale: why did nobody call me before that zero went in?
Love the coat, by the way.
Don't manage me, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and I'm still waiting for your answer.
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.
I'm not here to be chill, Hale. My son has a zero and a classroom full of people who saw it. Why did nobody call me first, or am I going to the principal's office with no answer?
